div.head: Norðleoda Inscr.
div.ab: The law of the North people
The law of the North-people. (Of wergild[s, Ld] hlq).
div.note: Liebermann prints D (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 201, p. 102, after Geþyncðo, c. 1060), H (Textus Roffensis f. 93v, after Geþyncðo, c. 1120) and Ld (Lambarde's print), with the Quadripartitus. K is H; D is also given here. H's heading is in red. ‘Nordleute’ are the Anglo-Scandinavians of northern England. Liebermann dates the core c. 920–954; the language of the archetype and the compilation need only date from c. 1050; the compiler perhaps also wrote or knew Geþyncðo and Mirce, and was perhaps a Mercian. ‘hlq’ is the exemplar of H and lq (lq = exemplar of Ld and the Quadripartitus). Clause number standardised from ‘Norðleod Inscr.’.
